faq.q: How much does Diaz & Nunez Elorza charge?
faq.a: Diaz & Nunez Elorza publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Diaz & Nunez Elorza offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Diaz & Nunez Elorza does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does Diaz & Nunez Elorza have offices?
faq.a: Diaz & Nunez Elorza publishes one office, in Coral Gables. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Diaz & Nunez Elorza?
faq.a: Diaz & Nunez Elorza names two attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Diaz & Nunez Elorza publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Diaz & Nunez Elorza publishes four case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
